title: Part Manifest
description: Tracks each physical part in a project: its file, material/color, origin alignment, units, and licensing source. Prefer separate aligned STLs per color/material over a single fused mesh.

assembly_intent.description: Computed summary of what the selected manufacturing_option (see build_plan.json) means for assembly - never a fabricated part breakdown. Written by `factory choose-option`. See factory.manufacturing.manifest.compute_assembly_intent.

transform_notes.description: Free-text notes on origin/transform alignment shared across parts, e.g. 'origin at plate center, Z-up'.

source.description: Where this part's geometry came from, e.g. 'original design', 'OpenSCAD script', 'Meshy (approved <date>)'.

license.description: License/attribution for the geometry, e.g. 'original', 'CC-BY-4.0', 'user-provided licensed asset'.

role.description: The part's function in the assembly, e.g. 'base_plate', 'raised_letters', 'frame'.

source_scad.description: Expected or actual path to this part's parametric CAD source, e.g. 'cad/nameplate.scad'.

intended_material.description: Planning-time intended material, set before CAD/export exists. May be a 'TBD' placeholder until a human confirms it.

intended_color.description: Planning-time intended color, set before CAD/export exists. May be a 'TBD' placeholder until a human confirms it.

quantity.description: How many copies of this part are needed.

shared_origin.description: Whether this part is modeled at a shared origin with other parts in the same assembly (see transform_notes).

export_expected.description: Whether an STL export is expected for this part (true once planned, even before the file exists at file_path).
